value.name: Micky arrives unannounced
value.description: Micky shows up at Laurie’s house and knocks on the front door without warning.

value.name: Jimmy answers the door
value.description: Jimmy, Laurie’s husband, opens the door and greets Micky cautiously.
evidence: His ex-girlfriend's husband, JIMMY, 45, well off, answers the door.
LAURIE'S HUSBAND (WHISPERS) Micky, how's it goin'? Ya know I don't think Laurie's expecting --

value.name: Laurie confronts Micky at the door
value.description: Laurie comes up to the door and challenges why Micky is there.
evidence: LAURIE CARROLL, 32, dirty blonde, thin walks up.

value.name: Laurie denies visitation
value.description: Laurie tells Micky that it is not his visitation day and refuses to let him see Kasie.
evidence: This isn't your visitation day, Micky.

value.name: Micky asks to see Kasie
value.description: Micky says he only wants to say hi to Kasie and tries to get access to his daughter.
evidence: I just wanna say hi to Kasie.

value.name: Micky explains his absence
value.description: Micky says he will not be around next weekend and reminds Laurie that he has a fight coming up.
evidence: I have a fight I told you that.

value.name: Laurie accuses Micky of skipping visitation
value.description: Laurie snaps back that Micky is already abandoning the days he is supposed to have with Kasie.
evidence: Now you're ditchin' the days you DO have?

value.name: Micky appeals to Jimmy
value.description: Micky turns to Jimmy for help or acknowledgment as the exchange grows tense.
